guests.agesHint: Each child's age sets their rate.

home.eyebrow: Independent hotels and hostels in Colombia
home.title: Book directly with the hotel.
home.subtitle: Every hotel sets its own price, taxes included, and your confirmation arrives instantly.
home.searchFacts: Pay by card, PSE or Nequi · No VAT on lodging for foreign non-residents

profile.title: From the coast to the páramo
profile.body: In Colombia altitude sets the weather: the same weekend can mean the sea at 30 °C or a wool poncho at 14 °C. Pick your destination by the climate you want.
profile.chartLabel: Destinations with stays on Housetel, by altitude

featured.title: Stays on Housetel
featured.subtitle: Hotels and hostels selling their own rates here.

price.title: The price is the hotel's
price.body: Every rate comes from the hotel's own system, taxes included: what you see is what you pay.

tax.title: No VAT if you don't live in Colombia
tax.body: If you are a foreigner who doesn't reside in Colombia, lodging is VAT-free (Tax Code, art. 481). We take it off when you book.

checkin.title: Check-in starts when you book
checkin.body: You get a link to register your companions and pay the balance before you arrive.

hotels.title: Run a hotel or a hostel?
hotels.body: Manage reservations, rooms, payments and DIAN invoicing with Housetel, and sell direct here.

results.noDates: Pick your dates to see prices and availability.
results.emptyTitle: No stays available with those criteria
results.emptyBody: Try other dates, remove a filter or look at another destination.
results.emptyCityBody: These destinations already have hotels and hostels on Housetel:

card.pickDates: Pick dates to see the price.

policy.noPolicyDetail: You can cancel at no cost.

after.first_night: After that, the first night is charged.
after.percent: After that, {{value}} % of the booking is charged.
after.full: After that, the full booking is charged.

always.first_night: If you cancel, the first night is charged.
always.percent: If you cancel, {{value}} % of the booking is charged.
always.full: If you cancel, the full booking is charged.

hotel.noPhotos: This stay has no photos yet.

stay.title: Your stay
stay.promoInvalid: Code {{code}} doesn't apply to these dates or rates.

rooms.title: Rooms and rates
rooms.pickDates: Pick your dates to see prices and availability.
rooms.noneTitle: No rooms left for those dates
rooms.noneBody: Try other dates or fewer guests per room.
rooms.taxNote: Prices include VAT on lodging. If you are a foreigner who doesn't live in Colombia you don't pay it: we take it off when you book.
rooms.taxExemptNote: Prices without VAT on lodging (foreign non-resident).

summary.title: Your selection
summary.noCharge: Nothing is charged at this step.

hotel.notFoundBody: It may have stopped taking online bookings.

errors.too_soon: This hotel takes online bookings for arrivals from {{date}}.
errors.too_far: That date isn't open yet: the hotel takes arrivals until {{date}}.
errors.stay_too_long: Online bookings are for {{count}} nights at most.
errors.invalid_dates: Check the dates: check-out must be after check-in.

checkout.title: Confirm your booking

guest.title: Your details
guest.emailHint: With this email and your booking code you can come back to your booking.
guest.phoneHint: With the country code if it's not Colombian, e.g. +1 555 123 4567.
guest.documentHint: Optional for now: the hotel asks for it to register you at check-in.

exempt.title: No VAT on lodging
exempt.body: As a foreigner who doesn't live in Colombia you don't pay VAT on lodging (Tax Code, art. 481). The hotel checks your passport on arrival.
exempt.taxed: Lodging includes 19 % VAT. If you are a foreigner who doesn't live in Colombia, say so above and we take it off.

extras.title: Add to your stay
extras.subtitle: They are added to the booking total.

arrival.title: Your arrival
arrival.requestsPlaceholder: An extra bed, a high floor, a celebration… The hotel will do its best.

payment.title: Payment
payment.payNowBody: You pay {{amount}} by card, PSE or Nequi.
payment.payAtHotelBody: Nothing to pay now: you pay on arrival.
payment.payDepositBody: You pay the {{amount}} deposit your rate requires now and the rest at the hotel.
payment.offline: This hotel takes payment on arrival: you pay nothing online.
payment.secure: You pay on the hotel's gateway (Wompi). Housetel never stores your card details.
payment.hold: Your booking is held while you pay.

consent.title: Permissions
consent.data: I authorize {{hotel}} and Housetel to process my personal data to manage this booking, under the <privacy>data processing policy</privacy> (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012).
consent.dataRequired: We need your permission to manage the booking.
consent.marketing: I'd like to receive news and offers from {{hotel}}.

checkout.legal: By booking you accept <terms>Housetel's terms</terms>, the hotel's conditions and your rate's cancellation policy.

errors.noAvailabilityTitle: Your selection is no longer available
errors.noAvailabilityBody: Someone booked before you. Go back to the hotel to pick another room or other dates.
errors.invalidSelectionTitle: Your selection is no longer valid
errors.invalidSelectionBody: Go back to the hotel to pick your rooms.

confirmation.pendingBody: This takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
confirmation.unpaidBody: Complete the payment before {{time}} to confirm it.
confirmation.declinedBody: Nothing was charged. You can try again with another method.
confirmation.expiredBody: The time to pay ran out and we released the rooms. You can book again.
confirmation.keepCode: Keep the code: with it and your email you can come back to this page.
confirmation.portalHint: Register your companions, pay the balance and message the hotel.
confirmation.emailBody: Enter the email you booked with to see booking {{code}}.
confirmation.notFound: We couldn't find a booking with that code and email.

engine.unavailableTitle: This hotel isn't taking online bookings right now

settings.title: Booking engine
settings.description: Your direct booking page, your listing on the Housetel marketplace and the widget for your website.

engine.enabledHint: If you turn it off, your page and the widget say online booking is unavailable.
engine.colorHint: Buttons, selected dates and details on your page. The guest portal and the payment page use it too.
engine.contrastGood: Text on this color: {{ratio}}:1 · easy to read
engine.contrastLow: This color has little contrast on light backgrounds ({{ratio}}:1): pick a darker shade.
engine.logoHint: PNG or SVG with a transparent background; without one we use the hotel profile's logo.
engine.heroHint: Landscape, at least 1600 px wide. Without one we use your first featured photo.
engine.headline: Welcome line
engine.headlineHint: Up to 120 characters. It sits over the main image.
engine.termsHint: Guests see and accept them before paying.
engine.maxAdvanceHint: How many days ahead your calendar is open.
engine.plansHint: With none checked, every public rate is sold.
engine.noPlans: You have no active public rates.
engine.imageInvalid: Upload a JPG, PNG or WEBP image up to 10 MB.

listing.listedHint: Travelers find your hotel when they search your city. Your booking page keeps working even if you turn it off.
listing.taglineHint: Up to 140 characters. One line on what makes you different.
listing.photosHint: Pick up to 12 in the order you want to show them; the first one is the cover.
listing.noPhotos: Upload photos of the hotel or your room types to feature them here.
listing.descriptionHint: It comes from the property profile.
listing.preview: How you look in the results

embed.iframeHint: Paste it into your website's HTML where you want the search box.
embed.buttonHint: A button in your brand color that opens your booking page.
embed.promosHint: Guests type them on your page when the field is visible.
embed.promosHidden: The promo code field is hidden on your page.
